findings.label: Credentials committed to git
findings.detail: .env contains a live OpenAI key (sk-proj-...) and a SecureAI Guard token (sai_1d647983...). Remove from repo immediately, rotate both keys, add .env to .gitignore, and replace with .env.example containing placeholder values.

findings.label: 403 treated as block, not auth failure
findings.detail: guard_client.py returns GuardResult(blocked=True, confidence=1.0) on any 403 response. An expired or misconfigured token also produces a 403, causing every prompt to be silently hard-blocked by the Guard layer rather than failing open with unavailable=True.

findings.label: Lazy LLM client only partially lazy
findings.detail: _get_client() re-reads LLM_API_KEY at first call, but _BASE_URL, _MODEL, and _TIMEOUT are captured at module load time. Read all four config values inside _get_client() or document the process-restart requirement.

findings.label: No back-off on Guard retry
findings.detail: The retry loop in guard_client.py continues immediately after 4xx/5xx responses with no sleep or exponential back-off. Add asyncio.sleep between attempts or skip retrying on 429.
